channel.title: Knowledge Recorder Updates
channel.description: Signed macOS updates for Knowledge Recorder.

item.description:
## macOS
- The collapsed mini-player strip once again sits flush with the selected screen edge. - The expanded card retains its 12-point spacing. - macOS 27 panel sizing, monitor anchoring and stable repeated collapse/expand behavior remain intact.

Platforms included: **macOS**.
### macOS - Fixed the collapsed recorder strip floating away from the screen edge. Its window now matches the narrow strip and stays 12 points from the selected edge. - Expanding and collapsing preserve the selected monitor and edge, including multi-monitor layouts. - Resizing no longer overwrites the saved widget position. Edge snapping waits until the mouse is released. - The strip retains its recording, processing, meeting-detection and saved-status indicator dots.

## macOS
- Restored dragging the floating mini-player on macOS 27 Golden Gate. Move it by the timer, audio wave or an empty background area, including while another app is active. - Fixed the top-left mode icon shifting after its menu closes. - Added an accessible name and current-mode value to the mode selector.
Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple Silicon. This is a macOS-only update; Windows is unchanged.
